script_text: Aries, the cosmos is igniting a firestorm in your chart that you cannot afford to sleep through. Early week, your ruling planet Mars squares Saturn in your 10th House on Monday, pressuring career goals but Tuesday brings a Venus sextile to your 1st House, softening conflicts and boosting charm for love. Mid-week, the Sun trine Neptune in your 12th House on Wednesday dissolves confusion, opening intuitive clarity. Late week, Mercury enters your 5th House Thursday improving romantic communication, while a Jupiter opposition to Pluto Friday warns of money power struggles at work. Monday is your worst day due to the harsh Mars-Saturn square blocking ambition. Wednesday is your power day because Venus lights your 1st House with magnetic confidence. Channel Mars fire into one bold career move before Friday's Pluto tension. Follow for daily updates.
